questions.question: Two circles with centres O and P and radii 17 cm and 10 cm, respectively, intersect each other at A and B. The length of the common chord AB is 16 cm. What is the perimeter of the triangle OAP (in cm)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radii of the circles = 17 cm and 10 cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8254015eb58e58060806cfff37a92c7f6b14d394c2c021fe1a25443277f6d56.png] 

According to the diagram,

D is the intersecting point of OP with AB

AD = DB = 8 cm

AD is making 90° on OP

OA = 17

Now,

OD = √(17² - 8²)

⇒ √( 289 - 64)

⇒ 15

Again DP = √(10² - 8²)

⇒ √(100 - 64)

⇒ 6

So, OP = 15 + 6 = 21

So, perimeter of ΔOAP = 17 + 10 + 21 = 48

**∴ Required answer is 48 cm**

SP = MP - MP × Discount%

Price after 2nd discount = 21675 × 88/100

A man invests an amount of Rs. 1,05,750 at simple interest in the name of his son, daughter and his wife in such a way that they get the same interest after 3, 4 and 5 years, respectively. If the rate of interest is 5% per annum. then the amount invested for the wife is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total amount = Rs. 105750

Rate of interest = 5%

**Concept used:**

S.I = PTR/100

**Calculation:**

Let share of his son, daughter, wife be x, y, z

According to the question,

x × 3 × 5/100 = y × 4 × 5/100 = 5 × z × 5/100

⇒ 3x = 4y = 5z

LCM of 3, 4, 5 = 60

So, Ratio of x : y : z = 20 : 15 : 12

Now,

20 + 15 + 12 = 47

Here 47 = 105750

1 = 2250

12 = 27000

So, his wife got Rs. 27000

**∴ The amount invested for the wife is Rs. 27000**

questions.question:
Study the given bar graph and answer the question that follows.

A tea plantation company produces three varieties of tea-black tea, green tea, and herbal tea. The production of three varieties (in million tonnes) over a period of six years from 2014 to 2019, has been shown in the bar graph here. The X-axis represents the years and the Y-axis displays the production of the three varieties in million tonnes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aeabd5587d4540f0f34b80c50d89542013baaf53c0bac950430dd9f9d19ec57b.png] 

The average production of black tea in 2014, 2015, and 2018 is how much more or less (in million tomes) than the average production of green tea in 2016, 2017, and 2019?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total production of black tea in 2014, 2015, 2018 = 100 + 80 + 120 = 300

Average = 300/3 = 100

Total production of green tea in 2016, 2017, 2019 = 100 + 130 + 110 = 340

Average = 340/3 = 113.33

So, amount of less production of black = 113.33 - 100 = 13.33

**∴ Required answer is option 2**

A car takes 50 minutes to cover a certain distance at a speed of 54 km/h. If the speed is increased by 25%, then how long will it take to cover three-fourth of the same distance?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio = 100 : 125 = 4 : 5

Time ratio (for same distance) = inverse of speed ratio = 5 : 4

Initial time 5 units = 50 minutes ⇒ 1 unit = 10 minutes

Time for full distance at new speed = 4 units = 40 minutes

Time for 3/4 distance = 3/4 × 40 minutes = 30 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 30 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Initial speed (S₁) = 54 km/h

Initial time (T₁) = 50 minutes = 50/60 hours

Formula used: Distance = Speed × Time

 
• 
 
 
 
 Start
 End
 Total Distance (D)
 
 3/4 of Distance
 Speed 1: 54 km/h
 Speed 2: 54 + 25% = 67.5 km/h

⇒ Total Distance = 54 × (50/60) = 45 km

⇒ New Speed = 54 + (25/100) × 54 = 54 + 13.5 = 67.5 km/h

⇒ New Distance = 3/4 × 45 = 33.75 km

⇒ New Time = New Distance ÷ New Speed

⇒ New Time = 33.75 ÷ 67.5 = 0.5 hours

⇒ New Time in minutes = 0.5 × 60 = 30 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 30 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Relationship

For a constant distance, speed is inversely proportional to time (S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁).

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. For two equal distances with speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy/(x+y).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: If x+(1)/(x)=sqrt{13}, then one of the values x³-(1)/(x³) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x + 1/x = k, then x − 1/x = √(k² − 4).

Here, k = √13, so x − 1/x = √(13 − 4) = √9 = 3.

If x − 1/x = a, then x³ − 1/x³ = a³ + 3a.

Substituting a = 3, we get: 3³ + 3 × 3 = 27 + 9 = 36.

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x + 1/x = √13

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)² = (a + b)² − 4ab

a³ − b³ = (a − b)³ + 3ab(a − b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = (x + 1/x)² − 4(x)(1/x)

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = (√13)² − 4

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 13 − 4 = 9

⇒ x − 1/x = ±3

Taking x − 1/x = 3 (since the positive value matches the given options):

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3(x)(1/x)(x − 1/x)

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 3³ + 3 × 3

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 27 + 9 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Squares Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2. This is derived directly from expanding the whole square formula (x + 1/x)².

Difference of Squares Transition

The relationship between the sum and difference of reciprocal terms is given by the identity (x + 1/x)² − (x − 1/x)² = 4.

Sum of Cubes Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k. This comes from rearranging the expansion of (x + 1/x)³.

Difference of Cubes Identity

If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k. This is an essential shortcut for quickly solving differences of cubed terms in algebra.

questions.question: A rectangle with perimeter 50 cm has its sides in the ratio 1 ∶ 4. What is the perimeter of a square whose area is the same as that of the rectangle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter = 50 cm

Ratio of sides = 1 ∶ 4

**Concept used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(l + b)

Area of a rectangle = l × b

Area of a square = a²

Perimeter of square = 4a

**Calculation:**

Let sides of the rectangle x and 4x

Now,

2(x + 4x) = 50

⇒ 5x = 25

⇒ x = 5

So, area of the rectangle = 4x² = 4 × 25 = 100

a² = 100

⇒ a = 10

So,

Perimeter = 4 × 10 = 40 cm

**∴ The perimeter of the square 40 cm**

questions.solution:

‘8475639AB’ is divisible by 99

Divisibility law of 11 & Divisibility law of 9

**Calculation:**

⇒ 8 + 4 + 7 + 5 + 6 + 3 + 9 + A + B = 42 + A + B

⇒ A + B can be 3 or 12

From options,

only options 1 and 4 are satisfying as A + B = 12

⇒ 8 + 7 + 6 + 9 + 8 - 4 - 5 - 3 - 4 = 22 multiple of 11

questions.question: 24% of Reena’s salary is equal to 38% of Sunita’s salary. Veena’s salary is two-third of the total salary of Reena and Sunita. If Veena’s salary is Rs. 62,000, then Sunita’s salary is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Salaries Reena (R) : Sunita (S) = 38 : 24 = 19 : 12

Total units (R + S) = 19 + 12 = 31 units

Veena’s salary = 2/3 × 31 units = 62,000

31 units = 62,000 × 3/2 = 93,000 ⇒ 1 unit = 3,000

Sunita’s salary (12 units) = 12 × 3,000 = 36,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 36,000.**
